node.label: Linda Gordon
node.date_label: Heroes of Their Own Lives (1988) · Pitied But Not Entitled (1994) · The Great Arizona Orphan Abduction (1999)
node.description: Historian of gender, social policy and unequal power in American families. Gordon’s autobiographical account links her turn to women’s history with the women’s liberation movement. Her research on welfare and family violence treats domestic relations as public and political, while The Great Arizona Orphan Abduction reconstructs the interaction of race, family claims and local power through a tightly focused narrative.
